note: Fairfield County parcel polygons appear only in the SCDOT-hosted SC_Parcels ArcGIS service (MapServer/19), which returns 'Token Required' for the MapServer root, the layer, and the FeatureServer path. The county's viewers (qPublic, Schneider Beacon) are not a public query service and returned Cloudflare/403 to automated access. Commercial parcel vendors are paid downloads. No public, unauthenticated parcel service was found.
